name: questionnaire-platform
description: Dynamic Questionnaire Platform — monorepo (frontend, backend, shared).

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.pretest: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/telemetry
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/telemetry && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
